senses.gloss:
अपृक्त अ-पृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, unmixed, un-
combined; (अस्), m. (in Pāṇini) a word or an affix
consisting of a single letter, i. e. of one not combined
with another; (in the Prātiśākhyas) the preposition
आ and the particle उ.

अपृणत् अ-पृणत्, अ, अती, अत्, Ved. not fill-
ing, not propitiating by gifts; stingy.

अपृथक् अ-पृथक्, ind. not separately,
with, together with, collectively.
—अपृथग्-धर्म-
सील, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same religion.
—अपृथग्-
धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, regarding God in all things.

अपृष्ट अ-पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, unasked, unad-
dressed, not spoken to.

आपृच् आ-पृच्, cl. 7. P. A. -पृणक्ति, -पृङ्क्ते,
-पर्चितुम्, to fill, pervade; A. to satiate one's self; to
mix with.
आ-पृक्, ind., Ved. in a mixed manner, confusedly.

आ-पृच्छा, f. conversation, speaking to or with;
bidding farewell.

आपॄ आ-पॄ, Caus. P. -पूरयति, -यितुम्, to
fill, fulfil: Pass. -पूर्यते, to be filled, become full.

1. आ-पृच्छ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be saluted, to
be welcomed, to be honoured; laudable, commendable,
beautiful.

2. आ-पृच्छ्य, ind. having saluted, having bid adieu.
(In Rāmāyaṇa I. 72, 20, a form आ-पृष्ट्वा occurs.)
